reason: I have one apartment next to our house and my guests ask the same three questions, which I answer myself on my phone, even at night. Paying €150 plus €35 a month for a machine to tell them the Wi-Fi password makes no sense when I earn so little from it.
objection: I don't need it. Answering guests personally is part of my hospitality, and for one apartment it would cost me a big piece of what I earn in a season.
would_change_my_mind: If it were almost free for one apartment, like €5 to €10 a month with no setup fee, and only during July and August when I am too busy cleaning to answer.
